create.name: Ashtanga Yoga Eindhoven
create.bio:
Ashtanga Yoga Eindhoven is a small traditional shala in the Gestel district of Eindhoven, in the south of the Netherlands, run by Katia Garcia Gomez and Nick Evans. Both learned the method over many years in Mysore under Pattabhi Jois and later Sharath Jois, and both are authorised by the Sharath Yoga Centre. Katia began in 1999, travelled to Mysore every year from 2001, was authorised in 2006 and ran her own Mysore school in Oviedo, Spain, before teaching in cities from Lisbon to Helsinki. Since September 2026 she leads the daily classes, while Nick practises at the shala, covers classes and looks after its running.

The timetable is Mysore style from Monday to Thursday and on Sunday mornings, with a counted primary series class each Friday and no classes on moon days. Newcomers can start a two-month beginners' course on the first Monday of any month, learning the sun salutations, standing postures and the joining of breath, gaze and bandhas. Chanting is part of the practice: the teachers have recorded the opening and closing prayers and Vedic mantras they learned in Mysore so that students can chant along at home.

courses.title: Mysore memberships and drop-in
courses.description: Monthly memberships for unlimited Mysore practice or two classes a week, plus single classes for visitors or for trying the method. Students and job seekers can ask for a reduced rate.
courses.price: Membership: 20 euro's; Unlimited Mysore: 120 euro's (per month); Twice a Week Mysore: 90 euro's (per month); Single Mysore class: 25 euro's

courses.title: Ashtanga Yoga Beginners Course
courses.description: A two-month course taught by Katia, three early-morning classes a week, introducing the Mysore method: breath, posture and gaze, the bandhas, and the sun salutations and standing sequence. It starts on the first Monday of each month.

free_resources.title: Mantras
free_resources.description: Recordings of the Ganesha prayer, peace mantras and other Vedic chants the teachers learned from their chanting teacher in Mysore, with the Sanskrit text and meanings, to chant along with.

free_resources.title: Online videos: home practice and nadi shodhana
free_resources.description: A short video talk on keeping up a home practice with an introduction to alternate-nostril breathing as taught in Mysore, followed by written step-by-step instructions, plus recordings of the opening and closing prayers.
